answer: Trust-walk ranking: honest agents seed short random walks along attested work links on the ledger, and scores decay with each hop. A sybil cluster can mint endless identities, but it only touches the honest graph through a few attack edges, so the walks rarely reach it and its scores fade like an ember. To buy a haven of trust, the attacker must earn many real links from honest peers, each costing genuine work, which is a steep ledge to climb at scale.
